ITEM 1 | Square white plate, about 26 cm across, used as the scale reference; the food sits in its center-left area. | 0
ITEM 2 | Two pale grayish-blue fish-like fillets, moist and slightly translucent with a smooth, glossy skin surface and a faint sheen, folded over each other; together they cover roughly 15 percent of the plate, about 9 cm long and 4 cm wide, with a thickness of about 2 cm. | 130
ITEM 3 | Pale cream-colored piece with light green flecks and small darker herb specks, soft and slightly moist with a matte, finely grained surface, roughly 7 cm by 4 cm and about 2 cm thick, lying beside and partly under the fillets. | 70
ITEM 4 | Bright green shredded leafy greens, fresh and slightly wilted, with thin ruffled edges, scattered in a small cluster about 6 cm long across the top of the fillets and along one side; covers under 5 percent of the plate, about 1 cm tall. | 12
ITEM 5 | Thin fine green herb sprigs, a few small pieces scattered near the base of the food, each about 2 to 3 cm long, dark green and delicate. | 2
